text: {"lessons":["A quiet stretch is not a reason by itself to trade, but I should periodically check that my holdings and cash still match my goals and risk tolerance.","Recent gains and losses do not predict next month's prices, so I should avoid reacting to short-term fluctuations.","I should make each buy, sell, or hold decision on its merits, not to avoid realizing a loss or to enjoy locking in a gain."]}
